scripts.cf:build: node --check src/guard.js && node --check src/index.js && node --check src/production-superguard.js && node --check src/protection.js && node --check src/superguard.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('openapi.json','utf8'))"
scripts.cf:preview: npm run cf:build && npx wrangler versions upload
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run cf:build && npx wrangler deploy
